summary: rust-tests is enforced: a pull request run skips it when every workspace crate has a trusted per-crate note for its own key (signed by fractal-test on a fleet host, or by CI), instead of only reporting in shadow that it would have

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: rust-tests' enforce is true in .st/evidence-skip-policy.json: on pull_request runs a satisfied per-crate decision skips instead of running; merge-queue runs are unchanged (the check's events are pull_request only).

compatibility.detail: Read from the accepted base, so it applies to runs after it merges.

recovery.detail: Set enforce back to false (a one-line revert): rust-tests runs again on every pull request.
